data.summary:
ServiceNow Consultant with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, configuring, and implementing ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CMDB, HRSD, CSM, IRM/GRC, and Security Operations (SecOps). Experienced in Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, Risk, Compliance, Security Incident, and Vulnerability Management processes, along with Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB governance, Employee Center, Customer Service Management, workflow automation, integrations, and Service Catalog development. Skilled in ServiceNow platform customization using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP APIs, and reporting solutions. Strong experience working in Agile environments, gathering business requirements, delivering end-to-end ServiceNow implementations, supporting production environments, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive operational efficiency and business value.
Experienced in working closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to implement scalable ServiceNow solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen governance controls, and enhance user experience.
Strong background in ITSM implementations involving Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and SLA Management processes, with a focus on process standardization and operational excellence.
Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining CMDB foundations through CI lifecycle management, service relationship mapping, CMDB governance activities, CSDM alignment, data quality reviews, and reconciliation processes.
Extensive exposure to ITOM implementations including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, MID Server administration, infrastructure visibility improvements, dependency mapping, and operational monitoring integrations.
Worked on Hardware and Software Asset Management initiatives supporting asset onboarding, inventory governance, software compliance tracking, lifecycle management, asset reconciliation, and audit readiness activities.
Experienced in Security Operations implementations involving Security Incident Response and Vulnerability Response processes, integrating security tools, coordinating remediation efforts, managing security investigations, and supporting cyber risk reduction initiatives.
Strong understanding of Integrated Risk Management and GRC processes including enterprise risk assessments, policy lifecycle management, compliance monitoring, audit management, issue remediation, control testing, and third-party risk governance.
Hands-on experience configuring HR Service Delivery solutions including HR Case Management, Employee Center, lifecycle event automation, employee onboarding and offboarding processes, HR knowledge management, and employee self-service capabilities.
Experienced in implementing Customer Service Management solutions supporting case management, entitlement management, customer communication workflows, agent workspace customization, self-service capabilities, and customer support process improvements.
Familiar with Strategic Portfolio Management concepts including demand intake, project governance, resource planning, investment prioritization, portfolio reporting, and strategic initiative tracking.
Strong development experience using Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Data Policies, Flow Designer, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, Notifications, Scheduled Jobs, and Scripted REST APIs.
Skilled in designing workflow automation solutions using Flow Designer, custom actions, subflows, approval processes, task orchestration, event-driven automation, and IntegrationHub spokes.
Experienced in integrating ServiceNow with enterprise applications and third-party platforms using REST APIs, SOAP services, LDAP, SSO, Azure AD, Active Directory, Workday, SCCM, Jira, JSON, XML, and OAuth-based authentication mechanisms.
Knowledgeable in developing and enhancing user experiences through Employee Center, Service Portal, UI Builder, custom widgets, AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
Experienced in building operational reports, dashboards, Performance Analytics indicators, executive scorecards, compliance reporting solutions, and KPI monitoring frameworks to support business decision-making.
Strong understanding of ServiceNow security architecture including RBAC, ACLs, data protection controls, application security configurations, governance standards, and compliance requirements.
Involved in release management activities including update set migrations, deployment planning, instance cloning, family upgrades, patch validation, regression testing, production deployments, and post-release support.
Adept at troubleshooting complex platform issues, analyzing business requirements, preparing technical designs, conducting impact assessments, and delivering practical solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
Experienced working within Agile and Scrum teams, collaborating with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, HR stakeholders, PMO organizations, compliance groups, and business leadership throughout project delivery lifecycles.
Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills with experience facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, conducting solution demonstrations, supporting user adoption initiatives, and providing knowledge transfer sessions.
